1. Title and Extent of Application 
a) These regulations may be called Ibadat International University Undergraduate Programs Regulations, 
2021. 
 
b) The Ibadat International University reserves the rights to make appropriate amendments in these 
regulations as and when necessary. Such amendments shall govern all University students admitted 
under these regulations.

a) Retake examination can be considered under two extreme circumstances: 
i) Serious illness of the student or ii) death of an immediate family member.

d) In case of death of an immediate family member (Parent/Real Brother or Sister/Son or
